description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for updating the database schema, language strings, permissions, and UI elements associated with the 'Claim' feature in OrangeHRM version 5.5.0. It includes methods to create tables, modify existing tables, insert language groups and menu items, and set workflow states for claim process management.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for applying database schema changes, language string updates, permission settings, and workflow states related to the Claim module in OrangeHRM version 5.5.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, language string manipulations, permission insertions, menu setup, and workflow state insertions necessary for the claim feature in this migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.5.0'.

methods.name: checkClaimExists
methods.description: Checks if the 'Claim' menu item already exists in the database.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the screen ID for a given screen name.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Retrieves the parent menu item ID for a given menu title and parent ID.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts a new menu item into the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: deleteClaimWorkflowStates
methods.description: Deletes existing workflow states associated with the CLAIM workflow.

methods.name: removeMarketplaceTables
methods.description: Drops marketplace-related tables if they exist.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state transition with specified parameters.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns a LangStringHelper instance.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Method called from another migration class to fix currency ID column inconsistencies for MariaDB 12.0.

methods.name: changeClaimExpenseTypeTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the 'status' column in 'ohrm_expense_type' to boolean type.

methods.name: changeClaimEventTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the 'status' column in 'ohrm_claim_event' to boolean type.

methods.name: modifyClaimTables
methods.description: Alters claim-related tables' columns for compatibility and consistency.

methods.name: modifyClaimRequestCurrencyToForeignKey
methods.description: Replaces the 'currency' column in 'ohrm_claim_request' with a foreign key to the 'hs_hr_currency_type' table.
